title: Picture tags, more reference pictures and Motion only for cars
notes:
- Video inputs: every picture shows its tag (@Image1, @Image2 ...) and the clip shows @Video1. Hover an input to see it larger, with its tag
- Video prompt: tags are marked in your text. Hover a tag to see its picture, type @ to pick one
- Picture numbers pasted from other tools become our tags, and we ask you to check them. A tag without a picture stops the take and says which one
- A reference you name for the location, the light or the look is no longer treated as the car, and the assistant writes these tags too
- Reference pictures: up to 50 per take (36 on Seedance 2.0). Past the engine's own limit, the extra pictures are combined 4 to a reference
- Drafts finish at 1080p from their menu, after one check that shows the price, and drafts are kept 14 days now
- Mute input videos: your footage goes to Seedance without its sound, so its music cannot carry into the take (on by default, under Output)
- Portal Swapper: Motion only for cars. Only the car's movement is used and the new car comes from your references; keep the scene as filmed or rebuild it, with Shape detail
- Recast the shot: Cars in the shot. The car in each shot is rebuilt from your references too, with Shape detail
- Portal Swapper: Objects now take up to 10 pictures per take (9 on Seedance 2.0), shared with the references
- Typing stays smooth when a project holds many large pictures
- When Seedance flags the sound of a take, the card says so and offers Retry without sound
